observations: A single headlight assembly wrapped in clear plastic film.
Features a projector-style main lens and an amber side reflector.
Black plastic mounting brackets are visible at the top and bottom.
The lens appears clear through the plastic, but fine details are obscured.
Watermarks 'PUREGOLD GLOBAL' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are present on the image.

claims.claim: Toyota and Lexus genuine spare parts
claims.evidence: No manufacturer logos (Toyota, Lexus, or Koito) or part numbers are visible in the photo.

claims.claim: available both new and fairly used
claims.evidence: The plastic wrap makes it difficult to distinguish between a new part and a refurbished/cleaned used part.

risks.risk: Broken or repaired mounting tabs hidden by the wrap or angle.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the back and all mounting points without the plastic wrap.

risks.risk: Internal electrical failure or missing HID ballasts/bulbs.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear sockets and electrical connectors.
risks.if_unproven: as an empty shell without electronics

risks.risk: Incorrect vehicle fitment (e.g., specific year or trim level).
risks.proof: Photo of the manufacturer's sticker or embossed part number on the housing.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the headlight showing the manufacturer's label and part number.
Close-up photos of all mounting tabs to ensure they are not cracked or glued.
Photo of the rear electrical connectors and bulb sockets.
response.reason: The specific vehicle model and part number are not visible. Car part pricing is highly specific to the exact year and model of the vehicle, which cannot be confirmed from this single front-facing photo.
